sql: SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) c FROM items_g1 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) c FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) c FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT COUNT(*) total, COUNT(prc) priced, SUM(prc>50) over50 FROM items_g1;
SELECT COUNT(*) reviews, COUNT(rtg) with_rtg, SUM(CASE WHEN f.ref_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan FROM fdbk_g1 f;
SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(rtg) r, COUNT(DISTINCT ref_id) items FROM fdbk_g1;

SELECT AVG(avg_rtg) AS avg_item_rating, COUNT(*) AS n_items
FROM items_g1 WHERE prc > 50;

SELECT i.ref_id, i.avg_rtg, i.rtg_ct, ROUND(AVG(f.rtg),4) review_mean, COUNT(*) review_n
FROM items_g1 i JOIN fdbk_g1 f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
WHERE i.prc>50
GROUP BY i.ref_id
LIMIT 8;
